findings.issue: Each copy of a slate from storage to memory is a rotated loop (element 0 written before it, the test on idx + 32) instead of one copy line.
findings.rule: Known pattern P3/P7: a loop storing storP[i] to consecutive memory words for i < storP.length is the copy 'mem[p + 32 len 32 * n] = storP[0 len n]'; merge the peeled first element into it.

notes: Small contract, checked function by function. Live source loops: _addWeight and _subWeight (approvals[yays[i]] += / -= weight with the checked add/sub, Panic(50) bound on the memory copy), each printed after its rotated storage-to-memory copy in lock, free and both votes. etch's ordering loop is dead because of the zero immutable maxYays (artifact). launch, lift, the hat/live logic and getters checked; P8: hash scratch writes.
